text:
Anika: quick RFC follow-up — thinking about a lightweight split of profile-service into a small 'session-core' (hot KV, runtime state) and a thin 'session-adapter' (tenant-facing API, validation). goal is: clear KV/cache ownership, faster runtime extraction, and safer canary rollouts. sketch: https://redwood.internal/notes/session-split (internal).

Miguel: +1. main concern is cross-tenant cache invalidation and routing rules. don't want increased cache thrash or extra cross-region hops.

Elena: I hacked up an adapter prototype yesterday. idea: adapter implements a tiny gRPC surface: GetPrefix(ctx, req) -> {prefix, meta} and SetPrefix. core keeps the hot in-memory shard. adapter owns auth/tenant checks. rough interface:
```proto
service SessionAdapter {
  rpc GetPrefix(GetPrefixReq) returns (GetPrefixResp);
  rpc SetPrefix(SetPrefixReq) returns (SetPrefixAck);
}
```
Works locally. fallback is just proxying to core if the adapter is unavailable.

Sam: rollout question — can we canary by tenant? or is our infra easier per-route? My vote: tenant-level canary (10% of tenants -> 50% -> all). easier to reason about data-shard boundaries.

DevOps-Bot: deploy preview created for PR #4187 -> https://ci.redwood/4187 (preview env: preview-session-adapter-staging)

Miguel: quick perf tidbit from my microbench: prototype saved ~2.3ms median token latency for short sequences, 99th improved slightly, but cold-start CPU spikes when the adapter populates the prefix cache. we should measure warmup behavior.

Anika: noted. proposed next steps:
1) Add adapter interface to delivery API (backwards-compatible change)
2) Draft KV-ownership doc + compatibility matrix
3) Implement tenant-canary harness + observability (latency, cache hitrate, cpu spikes)

Volunteers: @Elena for doc, @Miguel for canary harness?

Elena: I'll take the KV ownership doc. I'll include compatibility table and an emergency fallback (proxy-to-core) with a runbook. will land a doc PR by end of week. :eyes:

Miguel: I'll own the canary harness and rollout script. I'll add alerting for spike detection and a dashboard panel for prefix miss-rate.

Sam: I'll run smoke tests when the preview is ready and do a small tenant soak in staging. ping me when the preview link is live.

Anika: thanks all — leaving this open for one week for comments, then we'll lock the plan and create the umbrella ticket for the refactor. :thumbsup:
